title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
text: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion ESMA is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive working environment in sync with the values and principles outlined in our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) Strategy. The DE&I Strategy aims to provide a solid framework for the next few years identifying the areas where the institution can direct its organisational efforts towards providing such an environment. primary_grey_background Among our priorities (2024-2027): white_background Advancing diversity in recruitment – diverse workforce, geographical balance and applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their age, gender, ethnicity or social origin, political or religious affiliation, disability or sexual orientation. white_background Raising awareness and fostering an inclusive behaviour white_background Developing monitoring tools white_background Embedding and linking DE&I white_background In the broader context, ESMA stands by the EU Commission’s Gender Equality Strategy to make significant progress towards a gender-equal Europe by 2025. In addition, it takes a proactive approach to diversity and inclusion, in line with the Charter on Diversity and Inclusion developed by the EU Agencies Network as well as in accordance with Article 1d of the Staff Regulations . primary_grey_background Gender representation at ESMA as of August 2026 Gender representation Grand Total Staff % Female 160 44% Male 202 56% Total 362 100% white_background Ratio male/female in managerial functions 2026 Female Managers 53% Male Managers 47% white_background   white_background
